name: Little Lights Remain TD
storyline: In Little Lights Remain, you step into the shoes of Knowi, a young guardian in a world where the balance between light and shadow is faltering. When mysterious forces begin snuffing out the tiny “lights” that sustain her homeland, Knowi sets off on a journey to protect them. Each of the game’s handcrafted stages takes her through forests, villages and forgotten ruins, where she must set up ingenious defenses, solve environmental puzzles and uncover fragments of the land’s lore. Along the way she befriends creatures and spirits who share tales of the long‑lost Light Remains and learn that her struggle is part of a larger story. With every choice you make and every tower you place, you influence how Knowi grows as a leader, always guided by kindness and respect for nature. The fate of the lights — and the hope of the world — rests in your hands.
summary: Little Lights Remain is a narrative-driven tower defense adventure set in the shared universe of Light Remains. Guide Knowi and her friends through handcrafted levels as they defend their homeland from encroaching darkness. Explore vibrant landscapes, solve puzzles and make choices that influence the story while strategically placing unique towers to repel waves of foes. Focused on themes of kindness, responsibility and respect for nature, the game rejects gratuitous violence in favour of clever tactics and heart. Whether you’re a fan of adventures, strategy or simply looking for an indie title with a warm soul, Little Lights Remain invites you on a journey where light and courage prevail.
